_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::structural_dynamics#3 — RHO_INF is a key of the nested section STRUCTURAL DYNAMIC/GENALPHA, not of STRUCTURAL DYNAMIC. Written one level up it is rejected at parse with 'Could not match this input' and the RHO_INF line echoed, so the mistake is loud rather than silent. Its default really is 1.0: on one single-HEX8 GenAlpha deck, the arm with no GENALPHA section and the arm with RHO_INF: 1.0 both pass the same result test pinned to 1e-9 (RHO_ONE_RESULT_FAILURES=0), and 4C prints the derived set 'rho=1 beta=0.25 gamma=0.5 alpha_f=0.5 alpha_m=0.5'. RHO_INF: 0.5 changes that set to 'rho=0.5 beta=0.444444 gamma=0.833333 alpha_f=0.333333 alpha_m=0' and moves the answer to 1.68598782665224066e-02. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.

_mutation.note: remove the pathology from the misplacement arm: leave the key out of STRUCTURAL DYNAMIC entirely. The parse error vanishes and EXIT_WRONG_SECTION becomes 0, so the fixture must go red.

remove the numeric contrast: give the RHO_HALF arm the default value. Its coefficients and its answer collapse onto the default arm's, so RHO_HALF_COEFFS and the wrong-answer line both change and the fixture must go red.
